name: solx-ls
description: Syntax highlighting, diagnostics, Outline symbols, run commands, completions, and hover documentation for Solx.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Highlighting, completions, and hover are available. Launching the interpreter for running or syntax checking requires workspace trust.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Editing tools work; running requires a saved file accessible to the extension host.

solx.executablePath.markdownDescription: Solx executable path or command name. Empty uses `solx` on PATH. Paths may be absolute or relative to the file's workspace folder; do not add quotes or arguments. Windows requires an `.exe`. For source checkouts, use `solx.cargoManifestPath` instead of a target-directory binary.

solx.cargoManifestPath.markdownDescription: Path to the Solx source checkout's `Cargo.toml`, absolute or relative to the file's workspace folder. When set, Cargo rebuilds as needed before runs and syntax checks. Requires Cargo on PATH and an empty `solx.executablePath`.

solx.completion.enabled.description: Suggest confirmed keywords, APIs, type annotations, and code snippets.

solx.hover.enabled.description: Show reference documentation for recognized built-ins and imported standard-library members.

solx.diagnostics.enabled.description: Check buffers with the real Solx lexer/parser in trusted workspaces. Windows uses temporary buffer snapshots; other platforms use stdin. Requires Solx check --json support. No Solx code or imports are executed.

solx.diagnostics.delayMs.description: Wait this many milliseconds after edits before checking syntax.

solx.diagnostics.checkNames.description: Also report definitely unbound names using conservative single-buffer analysis. Requires Solx 0.2. Does not resolve imports, types, or execution order.

solx.symbols.enabled.description: Show parser-derived declarations in Outline and Go to Symbol. Requires Solx 0.2 and workspace trust. Uses the same temporary buffer transport as diagnostics on Windows.

solx.diagnostics.timeoutMs.description: Time allowed for a syntax check, including Cargo compilation. Increase for a cold source build.
